blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the \textbf{Scenario-Actor}, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)一般依靠采样温度来调节其输出的随机性. 选择温度的主流方法通常涉及固定的、高压的全球设置和上下文或符号级的校正,而不是以几何解释的方式表示交流情景。 在这个作品中,我们引入了一个简单且可解释的温度选择框架,即\textbf{Scenario-Actor},它适应了所推断的情况特征的解码. 情景-actor从变形器隐藏状态中取出情景-相关结构,从情景嵌入中确定温度,这是交流环境的结构化几何表示. 经验结果显示,在Llama-3.1-8B-指令中,情景-参与者在互动社会情景中实现了强大的目标完成性能,在后续的开放式教学上取得了显著进展,与多个基线相比,在多回合对话上取得了竞争性表现。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) generate text by repeatedly sampling from a conditional next-token distribution. One of the simplest yet most consequential hyperparameters in language generation is the sampling temperature, which controls the sharpness of the next-token probability distribution and, in turn, the rigor and creativity of model output.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)通过从有条件的邻托式分布中反复采样生成文本. 语言生成中最简单但最间接的超参数之一,就是采样温度,它控制了下位概率分布的锐度,反过来又控制了模型输出的强度和创造性.

blocks.en: Existing systems typically set it globally or adapt it according to predictive uncertainty, context, or learned decoding objectives, which implicitly treat decoding primarily as a property of the model’s predictive state ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) . But socially situated language generation exposes a different source of variation: the interaction itself. A prompt conveys not only semantics but also implies a communicative setting. For example, the conversation could be either an academic discussion or a friendly chitchat, whose desired responses are either rigorous or open-ended, formal or casual. The optimal temperature is then circumstantial, varying across scenarios.
blocks.zh: 现有系统通常将其设定为全球范围,或根据预测不确定性、上下文或所学的解码目标加以调整,这些解码主要视为模型预测状态的财产(Dhuliawala等人,2024年;Wang等人,2020年)。 但处于社会位置的语言一代暴露了一种不同的变异来源:相互作用本身. 即时不仅传达语义,还暗示了一种交流环境. 例如,对话既可以是学术讨论,也可以是友好的聊天,他们希望得到的回答要么是严格的,要么是开放式的、正式的或随意的。 因此,最佳温度是偶然的,因情况而异。

blocks.en: In our controlled experiment, we decode 245 AgentSense ( Mou et al., 2025 ) social interactions with four fixed temperatures. We found that first, changing temperature substantially alters interaction quality, moving between mid-range temperatures flips 16 to 17% of individual goal outcomes; second, globally strongest temperature setting does not dominate across interactions.
blocks.zh: 在我们的控制实验中,我们解码了245 AgentSense(Mou等人,2025年)四个固定温度的社会相互作用. 我们发现,首先,温度变化会大大改变相互作用的质量,在中程温度之间移动会翻转16至17 %的单个目标结果;其次,全球最强温度的设定不会在相互作用中占主导地位。

blocks.en: Such results show a major limitation of viewing temperature as a globally fixed hyperparameter, which motivates us to propose a way to control scenario-aware interaction and language generation. In this work, we propose Scenario-Actor , a framework for scenario-adaptive temperature selection. Scenario-Actor focuses on social interactions and open-ended instruction following, where the prompt provides enough evidence to infer a communicative scenario. We introduce a structured representation of the communicative setting extracted from context - the scenario embedding 1 1 1 In this work, we use the terms scenario vector and scenario embedding interchangeably. , whose span defines the scenario space, and use it to derive the sampling temperature. Specifically, our method maps a representation from the r r -th layer of the Transformer to an m m -dimensional scenario space, where each prompt is represented by a scenario embedding. An Actout \operatorname{Actout} function then maps the geometry of this vector to a prompt-level sampling.

blocks.en: Prior work in social psychology provides us with a theoretical support by introducing DIAMONDS ( Rauthmann et al., 2014 ) , a working model of situation characteristics showing that human behavior varies with situation characteristics. We construct scenario axes from nine pre-defined scenario labels. At the end, five scenario axes are constructed, corresponding to five of the eight DIAMONDS - Duty, Intellect, Adversity, Negativity, and Sociality ( Rauthmann et al., 2014 ) . Evaluations across fixed and random temperature policies, nucleus sampling ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ) , and EDT ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) baselines indicate Scenario-Actor’s competitive performance on interactive social scenarios, open-ended instruction following, and multi-turn dialogue compared to most decoding strategies.
blocks.zh: 之前在社会心理学方面的工作通过引入DIAMONDS(Rauthmann 等人,2014年)为我们提供了理论支持,这是一种情况特征的工作模式,表明人类的行为随情况特征而不同. 我们从九个预设的情景标签中构建情景轴. 最终构建了5个情景轴,对应了8个DIAMONDS中的5个—职责,知识,逆境,疏忽,以及社会(Rauthmann等人,2014年). 跨越固定和随机温度政策、核心取样(Holtzman等人,2020年)和EDT(Zhang等人,2024年)基线的评价表明,与大多数解码策略相比,情景-actor在互动社会情景上的竞争力表现、后续的开放式指导以及多回合对话。

blocks.en: An autoregressive language model generates a response one token at a time. In each next-token generation, a trained neural network first produces a set of scores, which we call logits, from the prompt 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and the generated tokens over the vocabulary 𝒱 \mathcal{V} that represents all possible next tokens. A Softmax \operatorname{Softmax} function then transforms these logits to a distribution that gives how likely a token is to be the next. Let y t y_{t} and y < t y_{<t} be the t t -th token to be generated and already generated, and z t , v z_{t,v} be the t t -th logits of the token v v in the vocabulary. blocks.en: Early work and much of engineering practice predominantly relied on manually chosen global decoding strategies for task-specific models, such as beam search, top-k, and fixed sampling temperatures. Holtzman et al. (2020) showed that in open-ended text generation, likelihood-maximizing decoding methods often lead to bland, repetitive, and degenerate outputs, and proposed nucleus sampling (top- p p ) as a more effective alternative. Zhang et al. (2021) examined the trade-off between quality and diversity in different decoding strategies. Their findings indicate that all decoding methods perform similarly when diversity is a priority, but nucleus sampling ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ) consistently outperforms all other evaluated algorithms when quality is viewed as more important. Wiher et al. (2022) revealed that the effectiveness of decoding strategies is highly task-dependent. Later in LLM era, Shi et al. (2024) made a more systematic horizontal comparison among decoding methods and revealed that decoding method performance strongly depends on task, model size, alignment, and quantization.

Holtzman等人(2020年)表明,在可自由限定的文本生成中,可能性最大化的解码方法往往导致乏味、重复和退化的输出,并提议将核心取样(top-p )作为更有效的替代品。 张等人(2021年)研究了不同解码策略中质量与多样性的权衡. 它们的调查结果表明,当多样性是优先事项时,所有解码方法的运作都相似,但核心取样(Holtzman等人,2020年)在质量被视为更为重要时,其业绩始终高于所有其他评价算法。 维赫尔等人. blocks.en: Fixed decoding hyperparameters are not always optimal at every decoding step. An early token-level architecture begins with Chang et al. (2023) , who proposed to relax the fixed-temperature assumption and adjust temperature dynamically according to its relevance to the source through KL-divergence. Zhu et al. (2024) further put forth EDT, which adjusts temperature directly from token-level entropy to better balance quality and diversity.

blocks.en: Another line of work concerns selecting sampling temperature from context. Wang et al. (2020) proposed contextual temperature, which learns a context-dependent temperature vector over the output vocabulary. Li et al. (2024) proposed DDS for open-domain dialogue system. DDS copes with two situations - chit-chat and factual QA - and maps context-dependent diversity score to a single decoding temperature. Dhuliawala et al. (2024) introduced adaptive decoding, which allows temperature to be predicted either once per example or dynamically at each decoding step.
blocks.zh: 另一项工作涉及从上下文中选择采样温度。 王等编. (2020年)提出上下文温度,在输出词汇中学习到一个上下文依赖的温度矢量. 李等人(2024年)提出开放域对话系统DDS. DDS处理两种情况 -- -- 聊天和事实性QA -- -- 并将依赖上下文的多样性分数映射到单一解码温度。 Dhuliawala等人(2024年)引入了适应性解码,这使得温度可以在每个实例中一次预测,也可以在每个解码步骤中动态预测.

blocks.en: 3 The Scenario-Actor
blocks.zh: 3 假想演员

blocks.en: Most modern LLMs are built using the celebrated Transformer architecture. In our framework, we assume that our prompt context is represented by a Transformer model and take the r r -th layer hidden-state matrix as input. The Scenario-Actor has two fundamental parts: Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} and Actout \operatorname{Actout} . 2 2 2 The module names Scenarize and Actout reflect our view that a prompt induces a latent scenario, and the model acts out, or decodes, from that scenario accordingly. Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} takes the hidden-state matrix at the r r -th Transformer layer as its input and outputs the scenario embedding ; Actout \operatorname{Actout} takes a scenario embedding and maps it to a prompt-level sampling temperature T T .
blocks.zh: 大部分现代LLMS都是使用著名的变形器架构建造的. 在我们的框架中,我们假设我们迅速的背景是以变形器模型为代表的,并以r-r-th层隐藏状态矩阵作为输入. 假想演员有两个基本部分: Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize}和 Actout\operatorname{Actout}. 2 2 2 模块名称Scenarise和Actout反映了我们的观点,即即即时诱发一种潜在的情景,而模型则相应地从该情景中采取行动或解码。 Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize} 以 r -th Transformer 层的隐藏状态矩阵作为输入并输出情景嵌入; Actout\operatorname{Actout} 将情景嵌入并映射到快速采样温度 T T 。

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate our proposed Scenario-Actor framework on benchmarks covering interactive social scenarios, open-ended instruction following and multi-turn question answering to test its performance on context-rich and socially-situated interactions. We also use GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) as a task-only stress test to study the boundary of scenario-based decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们提议的情景-行为体框架,该框架涉及互动社会情景的基准、后续的开放式指示和多回合问题回答,以检验其在环境丰富和社会背景互动方面的表现。 我们还使用GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)作为只任务应力测试,研究情景解码的边界.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Backbone model
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 后骨模型

blocks.en: Despite the outstanding performance of mainstream LLMs such as ChatGPT and Gemini, we do not have access to the hidden states with API calls. Therefore, we use the open-weight Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) as our backbone model. The model is used for both hidden-state extraction and generation.
blocks.zh: 尽管ChatGPT和双子座等主流LLMs的出色表现,但我们无法通过API调用进入隐藏状态. 因此,我们采用开放式Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(Grattafiori等人,2024年)作为我们的骨干模式。 该模型既用于隐藏状态提取,也用于生成.

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Data

We collect 37,357 conversational prompts from human-human and human-LLM interaction corpora, including WildChat ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) and DailyDialog ( Li et al., 2017 ) , together with targeted supplementary datasets for under-represented scenario types. Each prompt is annotated by GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) with one of nine scenario labels. A confidence-based filtering is applied to construct a high-confidence supervision set, resulting in 34,427 training prompts for triplet construction and 2,930 validation prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了来自人与人和人与LLM互动的37,357个对话提示,包括WildChat(Zhao等人,2024年)和DailyDialog(Li等人,2017年),以及代表性不足情景类型的定向补充数据集. 每个提示由GPT-4o(OpenAI,2024 )注释,并附有9种情景标签之一. 采用基于信心的过滤方法来建造一套高自信的监理装置,结果产生了34 427个三重施工培训提示和2 930个验证提示。

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Baselines

We compare Scenario-Actor against fixed-temperature decoding at T ∈ { 0.5 , 0.7 , 1.0 , 1.5 } T\in\{0.5,0.7,1.0,1.5\} , greedy decoding, random temperature selection, nucleus sampling ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ) with p = 0.95 p=0.95 and T = 1.0 T=1.0 , and entropy-driven temperature decoding (EDT) ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . EDT is included as a training-free and directly reproducible adaptive baseline. DDS and LPO ( Li et al., 2024 ; Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ) both, in contrast, require training additional components. LPO trains its decoder module via preference optimization over sampled outputs, and DDS trains a diversity regressor designed for a two-way chit-chat vs. QA distinction, with, to our knowledge, no public implementation. Reproducing either method involves substantial heuristic design choices of our own, making the comparison hard to attribute in either direction.

blocks.en: 4.1.4 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.1.4 详细执行情况

blocks.en: Llama-3.1-8B has 32 Transformer layers. For all experiments, we use the hidden states at the 16th Transformer layer. We found that scenario geometry collapses with deeper Transformer layer, which we discuss in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: Llama-3.1-8B有32个变形器层. 对于所有实验,我们使用第16变形器层的隐藏状态. 我们发现,情景几何崩溃 与更深的变形器层, 我们在4.4节讨论。

blocks.en: Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} maps the above hidden states into a 32-dimensional scenario embedding. The implementation follows Equation 1 , where r = 16 r=16 is the Transformer layer, ϕ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) = tanh ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \phi(\cdot)=\operatorname{tanh}(\cdot) is the activation function. Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} is trained according to Equation 2 with squared Euclidean triplet loss with margin β = 0.3 \beta=0.3 . AdamW with learning rate 3.0e-4, weight decay 1.0e-4, gradient clipping at 1.0, and early stopping based on validation recall@1 is used as optimizer.
blocks.zh: Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize} 将上面隐藏的状态映射为32维的情景嵌入. 执行遵循方程式1,其中r = 16 r = 16是变形器层,φ(⋅) = tanh ⁡ (⋅)\phi(\)\operatorname{tanh}(\)\cdot)是激活函数. Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize}按照方程式2进行训练,平方为欧几利得三重损失,差值β=0.3\β=0.3. 亚当W的学习速率3.0e-4,重量衰减1.0e-4,梯度剪切为1.0,基于验证召回的早期停止@1被用作优化器.

blocks.en: We operationalize five DIAMONDS dimensions with nine scenario labels. We compute the centroid of each scenario label as a subscenario vector and use these vectors to define each scenario axes. GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) is used as an LLM annotator for the training set. The nine scenario labels are rigorous, brainstorming, formal, playful, adversarial, institutional, casual_conversation, emotional_support_pos, and emotional_support_neg.
blocks.zh: 我们操作了5个DIAMONDS维度,并有9个情景标签。 我们计算每个情景标签的中间体作为子情景矢量,并利用这些矢量来定义每个情景轴. GPT-4o(OpenAI,2024)用作训练集的LLM注释器. 九种情景标签是严谨的,集思广益的,正式的,玩弄的,对抗的,体制的,随意的_对话的,情感的_支持_pos,和情感的_支持_neg.

blocks.en: Five scenario axes - institutional vs. casual_conversation, rigorous vs. brainstorming, adversarial vs. non-adversarial; emotional_support_pos vs. emotional_support_neg, and formal vs. playful were constructed from combinations of nine subscenario vectors. Non-adversarial is the average over all subscenario vectors that are not adversarial. Detailed description of each scenario can be found in Appendix C . Such five scenario axes match five of the DIAMONDS: Duty, Intellect, Adversity, Negativity, and Sociality ( Rauthmann et al., 2014 ) .
blocks.zh: 五个场景轴 - 机构对随机_对话,严格对集思广益,对抗对非对抗;情感_支持_pos对情感_支持_neg,形式对玩法由9个子场景载体的组合构建. 非对抗性是所有非对抗性子行为媒介的平均值。 附录C详细介绍了每一种情况。 这五个情景轴与DIAMONDS的五个情景轴相匹配:职责、知识、逆境、疏忽和社会(Rauthmann等人,2014年)。

Actout \operatorname{Actout} then maps a scenario embedding generated from Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} to a temperature within the range [ 0.30 , 1.50 ] [0.30,1.50] corresponding to Equation 3 . In our experiment, we fixed ( τ i + , τ i − ) (\tau_{i}^{+},\tau_{i}^{-}) for all benchmarks and comparisons.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Result
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: We evaluate Scenario-Actor across three benchmarks - AgentSense ( Mou et al., 2025 ) , AlpacaEval ( Dubois et al., 2024 ) , and MT-Bench ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) - covering situational goal-completion, open-ended instruction following, and multi-turn interactions with respect to all baselines. Goal completion score, Length-Controlled Win Rate (LC-WR), and GPT-4 score were metrics for each of the three main evaluations. The performance is shown in Table 1 . Scenario-Actor significantly outperforms most decoding methods on AgentSense and all baselines on AlpacaEval, while remaining competitive on MT-Bench in our experiment.
blocks.zh: 我们从三个基准来评价情景-参与者 -- -- Agent Sense(Mou等人,2025年),AlpacaEval(Dubois等人,2024年)和MT-Bench(Zheng等人,2023年) -- -- 涵盖情况目标完成、后续的开放式指示以及所有基线的多回合互动。 目标完成得分、长控制赢率(LC-WR)和GPT-4得分是三项主要评价中每项评价的衡量标准。 执行情况见表1。 场景-演员在AgentSense和AlpacaEval的所有基线上都大大超过大多数的解码方法,同时在我们实验中仍然对MT-Bench有竞争力.

blocks.en: Among available benchmarks, AgentSense directly evaluates the setting targeted by Scenario-Actor: interactive dialogue in which the model must adapt to complete different goals as the social context develops. Scenario-Actor achieves the highest goal completion score of 0.8015, outperforming greedy decoding, every fixed-temperature setting, EDT, nucleus sampling, and Random- T T . Scenario-Actor attains significant improvements over all baselines on the range from 3.16 to 10.26 percentage points except for fixed T = 0.7 T=0.7 at 0.7801, for which Scenario-Actor’s 2.14 percentage points advantage is not statistically significant.
blocks.zh: 在现有的基准中,AgentSense直接评价了情景-行为者目标设定:互动对话,在这一对话中,模型必须适应随着社会环境的发展而完成不同的目标。 假想-演员达到最高目标完成分数0.8015,超过业绩贪婪的解码,每一次固定温度设定、EDT、核取样和Random-T T。 假想-演员在所有基线上都取得了显著的改善,从3.16到10.26个百分点不等,但0.7801的固定T=0.7T=0.7,而假想-演员2.14个百分点的优势在统计学上并不显著。

blocks.en: On AlpacaEval, Scenario-Actor achieves the strongest result among all tested methods with 30.03% Length-Controlled Win Rate (LC-WR), outperforming the best fixed-temperature baseline by 4.35 percentage points, EDT by 4.45 percentage points, and exceeding nucleus sampling, greedy decoding, Random- T T , and class-conditioned T T with statistical significance. On MT-Bench, our framework scores 7.91, which is significantly above fixed T = 1.0 T=1.0 , fixed T = 1.5 T=1.5 , Random- T T , nucleus sampling, EDT, and class-conditioned T T , and is potentially competitive among greedy decoding, fixed T = 0.5 T=0.5 , and fixed T = 0.7 T=0.7 . Detailed statistical report can be found in Appendix B .

blocks.en: To justify the use of LLM for scenario annotation and results judging, we compute both the LLM-human and human-human agreement on the models we used. A gold set on scenario annotation consisting of 306 prompts and a gold set on evaluation consisting of 50 AlpacaEval examples and 50 MT-Bench examples were manually annotated by us. The results show that the GPT-4o annotator agrees with each human annotator at κ = 0.82 \kappa=0.82 and 0.85 0.85 . The GPT-4-turbo ( OpenAI, 2023 ) AlpacaEval judge reaches κ ≈ 0.72 \kappa\approx 0.72 with each annotator; for MT-Bench scoring, it correlates with human raters at Pearson r = 0.92 r=0.92 and 0.86 0.86 ; for AgentSense, it achieves agreement rates of 80% and 72% with the two human judges, comparable to the human-human agreement of 76%, and with Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.48 and 0.27, respectively. blocks.en: To validate if Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} learns meaningful scenario geometry, we visualize the learned scenario space using both PCA and UMAP. PCA shows the global variance structure of 900 scenario embeddings, with 100 examples from each scenario label. The first two principal components explain 27.9% and 21.8% of the variance respectively. As shown in Figure 4 , nine centroids obtained from nine scenario labels occupy different regions in scenario space. PCA view also shows the five proposed scenario axes used in our experiment - Duty, Intellect, Negativity, Sociality, and Adversity. The patterns therefore reflect that Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} learns a structured scenario space.
blocks.zh: 要验证是否 Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize} 学习有意义的情景几何, 我们使用 PCA 和 UMAP 两种方法可视化学到的情景空间 。 PCA显示900种假想嵌入的全局差异结构,每个假想标签都有100个实例. 前两个主要组成部分分别解释了差异的27.9%和21.8%。 如图4所示,从9个情景标签获得的9个百分行星在情景空间中占据不同区域。 常设仲裁法院的观点还显示了我们在实验中使用的五个拟议情景轴 -- -- 责任、知识、疏忽、社会和逆境。 因此图案反映了Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize}学习了结构化的情景空间.

blocks.en: UMAP further confirms local structure of the learned space. The projection achieves a trustworthiness score of 0.96 using cosine distance. The embedding exhibits meaningful relationships among the nine scenario types. Semantically related scenarios also cluster near one another; for example, institutional prompts lie closer to rigorous prompts than to casual conversation.
blocks.zh: UMAP进一步证实了学习空间的局部结构. 投影利用余弦距离达到可信赖度0.96分. 嵌入在九种情景类型之间显示出有意义的关系。 与语义相关的假设情况也相互接近;例如,机构提示更接近于严格的提示而不是偶然的对话。

blocks.en: To study the boundary of Scenario-Actor, we tested its performance on GSM8K against all other baselines. Scenario-Actor significantly underperforms greedy decoding, fixed T = 0.5 T=0.5 , fixed T = 0.7 T=0.7 , EDT, and insignificantly lower than Random- T T baseline by 0.53.

In theory, GSM8K would exhibit better performance of the model when the sampling temperature is lower. In our experiment, Scenario-Actor selects a GSM8K temperature less than ideal. Nearest-centroid analysis shows that the distribution is concentrated in adversarial, institutional, and brainstorming scenarios, which together account for 77.9% of GSM8K prompts. Only 5.0% are mapped to the rigorous scenario.

The current geometry does not reliably map task-only mathematical prompts to a low-temperature rigorous regime, and Scenario-Actor fails to infer the “scenario” of GSM8K prompts. The result illustrates the scope and boundary of Scenario-Actor to be a decoding framework for prompts whose communicative scenario can be inferred from context.

blocks.en: We examine the temperatures selected by Scenario-Actor across all benchmarks. Scenario-Actor operates within the range of [ 0.67 , 1.16 ] [0.67,1.16] across turns generated by the evaluated Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, [ 0.77 , 1.01 ] [0.77,1.01] on AlpacaEval, and [ 0.76 , 1.02 ] [0.76,1.02] on MT-Bench. AgentSense temperatures also change with dialogue context, with the mean temperature increasing by approximately 0.16 across turn positions.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了情景-演员在所有基准中选择的温度。 假想-actor在阿尔帕卡埃瓦尔的Llama-31-8B-Instruct,[0.77,1.01][0.77,1.16][0.67,1.16] 和MT-Bench上的[0.76,1.02][0.76,1.02] 所生成的转弯范围内运行. 代理温度也随着对话环境的变化而变化,平均温度在转弯位置上大约上升0.16。

blocks.en: We compare outputs generated by Scenario-Actor under short context with only one prior turn versus long context with all prior turns on 100 DailyDialog multi-turn conversations. Long context Scenario-Actor achieves a win rate of 67.0% over short context with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval of [58.0%, 76.0%] in pairwise GPT-4-turbo evaluation. The finding supports our claim that scenario is generally expected to be more identifiable with more context, which motivates the RNN formulation of Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} .
blocks.zh: 我们比较设想-演员在短背景下产生的产出,只比较前一个转折与后一个转折与前100次DailyDialog多角度对话。 长背景假想-演员在短背景评价中实现67.0%的胜率,95%的靴子置信间隔为[5.8.0%,76.0%],成对的GPT-4涡轮机评价. 调查结果支持了我们的说法,即一般预计情况会随着更多的背景而更加明确,这促使RNN的配方Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize}.

blocks.en: We measure the latency, memory usage, and throughput of Scenario-Actor over 80 MT-Bench prompts on a single NVIDIA A10G 24 GB GPU ( ml.g5.2xlarge ). Latency includes hidden-state extraction, Scenarize, Actout, and response generation. As shown in Appendix A , Scenario-Actor has similar end-to-end latency and throughput to the tested decoding baselines. Latency is within 2.5% of greedy decoding, while the output and request throughput remain close to standard sampling methods. Peak allocated memory is also nearly unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们测量一个单 NVIDIA A10G 24 GB GPU(ml.g5.2x group )上的 80 MT-Bench 显示器的纬度、内存使用情况和吞吐量。 延迟包括隐藏状态提取,Scenarise,Actout,以及反应生成. 如附录A所示,情景-actor与经测试的解码基线具有类似的端对端延时性和吞吐量. 延迟在贪婪解码的2.5%以内,而输出和请求的吞吐量仍然接近于标准的采样方法. 高峰分配的内存也几乎不变.

blocks.zh: 4.4 违约

blocks.en: To test whether the gains come from the scenario geometry or from the manually-specified endpoint temperatures, we add a class-conditioned temperature baseline which uses the same Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} module but removes Actout \operatorname{Actout} ’s geometric weighting. Class-conditioned baseline treats the nearest centroid as the prompt’s class label and assigns its sampling temperature from corresponding endpoint.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这些增益是来自场景几何还是来自人工指定的终点温度,我们增加了一个类条件温度基准,该基准使用相同的Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize}模块,但删除了Actout\operatorname{Actout}的几何加权。 具有类条件的基准将最接近的百分点作为催化剂的类标签,并从相应的端点指定其采样温度。

blocks.en: We observe that layer 16 produces stronger scenario axis separation and lower representation saturation than deeper layers such as layer 30. This observation aligns with recent work suggesting that structured semantic relation signals in LLMs often peak in intermediate layers rather than final generation-oriented layers ( Diera and Scherp, 2026 ) . Full layer-sweep diagnostics are reported in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们观察到,第16层产生比第30层等更深层更强的情景轴分离和较低的代表饱和度. 这一观察与最近的工作一致,认为LLMs中的结构语义关系信号往往在中间层中达到顶峰,而不是最终的面向生成的层(Diera and Scherp, 2026). 完整的分层诊断在附录D中报告。

blocks.en: We compare the default margin β = 0.3 \beta=0.3 against β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 while holding the architecture, training data, and inference protocol fixed. As in table 7 , increasing margin produces stronger centroid separation and improves GSM8K accuracy, but reduces performance on multi-turn and open-ended evaluation tasks. These results suggest that larger margins reshape the scenario geometry but does not uniformly improve generation quality.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose Scenario-Actor, a prompt-level temperature selection framework that maps a hidden-state matrix to a structured scenario embedding and derives a sampling temperature from its geometry along interpretable scenario axes. Comparisons of Scenario-Actor with multiple baselines show strong goal-completion performance on AgentSense, significant performance improvements on AlpacaEval, and competitive results on MT-Bench. In addition, we see Scenario-Actor as a step toward socially adaptive language models. As LLMs become embedded in human society through multimodal agents and embodied systems, their ability to recognize the situations they are in will become increasingly important. We hope this framework allows models to better understand social context, emotional nuance, and the expectations that shape human communication in the future.
blocks.zh: 我们提出情景-actor,一个快速的温度选择框架,将隐藏状态矩阵映射到结构化情景嵌入中,并从可解释情景轴的几何学中得出一个采样温度。 假想-演员与多个基线的比较显示,AgentSense目标完成性能强劲,AlpacaEval的性能显著改善,MT-Bench的竞争性结果. 此外,我们认为情景-演员是迈向适应社会的语言模式的一个步骤。 随着LLMS通过多式联运代理商和体现的系统而嵌入人类社会,它们认识到自身处境的能力将变得日益重要。 我们希望这个框架能让模型更好地了解社会背景,情感细微,以及未来塑造人类交流的预期.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Language models take only textual sequence as their input. In actual human-human interaction, scenarios are dependent on cues other than pure linguistic context. Therefore, current language models are still limited in their ability to fully integrate into all aspects of human interactions. The inference of scenario solely from linguistic context is itself insufficient.
blocks.zh: 语言模型仅以文字序列作为输入. 在人与人的实际互动中,情景取决于纯语言背景以外的提示。 因此,目前语言模型充分融入人类互动各个方面的能力仍然有限。 仅从语言角度推断情景本身是不够的。

blocks.en: Scenario-Actor is designed for settings with rich scenario cues, such as multi-turn conversations. But in our dataset, we see a great amount of them being straightforward and utilitarian. Many prompts ask the model to directly solve problems such as writing code, answering math or providing general information. Such a characteristic makes scenario inference almost impossible as task-oriented prompts often contain little evidence for a social setting. For these prompts, a standalone selector can route the input to a standard task-specific decoding policy, which is independent of our framework. This setup is also a compromise to current LLM usage as the language model itself is limited in its interaction modality. We expect this limitation to be alleviated in multimodal or embodied agent settings, where models can access richer interactional cues and become more deeply integrated into human social environments.
blocks.zh: 假想-代理设计用于具有丰富的假想提示的设置,如多回合对话. 但是,在我们的数据组中,我们看到很多数据是直截了当的和实用的。 许多提示要求模型直接解决诸如写代码,回答数学或提供一般信息等问题. 这种特征使情景推论几乎不可能,因为面向任务的提示往往很少包含社会环境的证据。 对于这些提示,一个独立的选择器可以将输入引向一个标准的任务特定解码政策,这个政策独立于我们的框架. 这种设置也是对当前LLM使用的一种妥协,因为语言模型本身在交互模式上是有限的. 我们期望在多种模式或体现的代理环境中减轻这一限制,在这种环境中,模型能够获得更丰富的互动提示,并更深入地融入人类社会环境。

blocks.en: The current study establishes the results and claims merely on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with the nine-label, five-axis scenario taxonomy. In theory, however, our framework is expected to be applicable to other model families and scenario taxonomies, which, due to limited budget and computational power, require more evaluations.
blocks.zh: 目前的研究仅确定了Llama-3.1-8B-指令的结果和主张,并附有9个标签,5轴假想分类法. 然而,从理论上讲,我们的框架可望适用于其他示范家庭和情景分类,由于预算和计算能力有限,需要更多的评价。

blocks.en: A key limitation of the current training data is that scenario labels are not fully balanced from data source. In an ideal setting, each scenario category would be represented across multiple corpora so that Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} would be forced to learn merely the scenario structure rather than dataset style. In practice, however, no available dataset covers all of our scenario labels with balanced coverage. We therefore rely on multiple supplementary sources. Developing a more balanced scenario dataset remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 目前培训数据的一个关键限制是,情景标签与数据来源之间没有完全平衡。 在理想的设定中,每个情景类别都会被代表到多个公司,这样Scenarize\operatorname{Scenarize}将被迫只学习情景结构而不是数据集风格. 然而,实际上,没有任何可用的数据集涵盖我们所有具有均衡覆盖的情景标签。 因此,我们依赖多种补充来源。 制定更加平衡的设想数据集仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: We keep the backbone model frozen and train only the Scenarize \operatorname{Scenarize} module, which maps the 4096-dimensional Llama hidden states into a 32-dimensional scenario embedding. All experiments run on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU with 24GB memory.
